messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
Given that the company works in mining areas (extractive sector), from which day does the IGEA-PRIM 5t overhead travelling crane at position 13 move from two-yearly to yearly verification?

response.text: Dato che l'azienda opera in aree minerarie (settore estrattivo), da quale giorno il carroponte IGEA-PRIM da 5t in posizione 13 passa dalla verifica biennale a quella annuale?
